entities.summary: Patience Ozokwor (b. 1958-09-14, Ngwo) was a visual artist or sculptor of the Contemporary era, characterized by technology, globalization, and rapid social change, active in Ngwo and Nigeria. Known in the fields of nigeria, composers & musicians, africa.
